First release of grstbx on PyPI:

```
pip install grstbx                 # library and web dashboard (grstbx-viewer)
pip install "grstbx[notebook]"     # + JupyterLab environment for the notebooks
```

## New

- **Web dashboard `grstbx-viewer`** to explore GRS products in the browser, without notebook: L2A and
  L2B products (Zarr stores, NetCDF products, hGRS L2A files), one image, a time series of products
  (paths or glob patterns, possibly on different grids) or a NetCDF datacube, chosen in a file browser
  of the server. L2A products are displayed with `ViewSpectral` (spectra), L2B products with
  `ViewParam` (time series, invalid pixels hidden). Spectra or parameters of the drawn points and
  statistics of the drawn polygons are exported for all the dates (CSV), the geometries as GeoJSON. The
  dashboard can be served on a network (`--address`). See the
  [dashboard tutorial](https://grstbx.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tutorials/dashboard.html).
- **Viewer controls** (`ViewSpectral`, `ViewParam`): contrast and brightness sliders; bands of the RGB
  composite (presets true colour, false colour, red edge, SWIR, or any band for each channel) and gamma.
  They are shown in the viewer, or placed elsewhere with `display_controls()` and `rgb_controls()`
  (`visu(controls=False)`), as in the sidebar of the dashboard. `title=` option to name the viewer after
  the sensor.
- **hGRS products** (hyperspectral GRS, EnMAP and PRISMA): `open_hgrs_l2a` opens an hGRS L2A NetCDF file
  as a GRS product and its ancillary data (aerosol, water vapor, sunglint), so that it can be cropped
  with `crop_l2a` and displayed with the viewers; `open_l2a` opens GRS and hGRS products.

## Fixes

- `SpatioTemp.clip_raster` clipped a square of side 1.41 `extent_m` instead of `extent_m`: the clipped
  areas of former runs are 2 times larger.
- `utm_projection` returns the plate carrée projection for longitude-latitude grids (e.g. the hGRS
  PRISMA products), which `plot_rgb` drew as web Mercator coordinates.
- The colormap menus of the viewers were clipped by the widget box: they are now drawn above the map.

## Documentation

- New tutorial pages: [web dashboard](https://grstbx.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tutorials/dashboard.html)
  and [hGRS products](https://grstbx.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tutorials/hgrs_products.html), with the
  PRISMA L1-to-L2A notebook.
- Harmonized titles, sections and captions of the tutorial notebooks.

Full history: https://grstbx.readthedocs.io/en/latest/history.html
